correctness.rationale: Cross-transversality is equivalent to mutual inverse identities for equal-rank isotone maps. The rank-two piecewise map interchanges the two nonidempotent regimes and fixes exactly b<=a<c. The rank-n-1 map interchanges missing-image positions to either side of its double block, fixing exactly b=a or b=a+1. Composition identities and parameter ranges are checked by direct proof. For n=5 rank three, 60-21=39 nonidempotents is odd and these cannot be fixed by an inverse involution because monotone maps with alpha^3=alpha are idempotent; the explicit twenty-pair certificate moves exactly one idempotent and is checked over all sixty rank-three maps. Finite tests through n=12 do not substitute for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The 2026 resolution of permutation matching existence leaves involution and fixed-idempotent behavior open. Uniform constructions on the two extremal nontrivial rank strata of an infinite family, together with the exact first possible idempotent-fixing obstruction and a sharp five-point attainment certificate, determine meaningful structural boundaries rather than arbitrary computations. The formula covers nondivisible cases outside the 2024 sufficient condition.
